links.outcome: Familiarity with ethics implementation knowledge of medical AI social experiments among hospital staff
links.effect: Only 2.4-9.6% of 332 respondents were familiar with ethics implementation knowledge; 31.9-86.1% held an 'agree' attitude, indicating a significant knowledge gap.
links.quote: 2.4-9.6% of participants were familiar with ethics implementation knowledge of MAI social experiments.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of pediatricians, nurses, and health IT staff evaluating knowledge and attitudes regarding ethics implementation in medical AI experiments; does not evaluate or compare a specific deployment practice intervention.
